title: Spring Herb Hummus Vegetable Garden
description: Kids will eat their vegetables when you make this adorable vegetable garden made with herbed hummus as the "grass" with the vegetables planted in rows.
ingredients: 2 (15 ounce) cans chickpeas (garbanzo beans), drained and rinsed
6 small carrots with greens still attached, or as desired
6 sugar snap peas, or as desired
6 radishes with greens, halved, or as desired
6 small stalks celery hearts with leaves, or as desired

steps.text: Blend chickpeas, tahini, water, lemon zest, lemon juice, basil, parsley, chives, mint, garlic, and salt in a blender until smooth. Spread hummus in a 2-inch deep baking dish.
Arrange carrots, sugar snap peas, asparagus, radishes, and celery in neat rows in the hummus to resemble a garden.

video.description: Bring some delight to the vegetable platter with this cute presentation that’s so fun that even kids are fooled into eating their veggies! Begin by making a tasty hummus dip by blending chickpeas, tahini, lemon zest and juice, basil, parsley, chives, mint, garlic and salt. Spread in a baking dish then arrange vegetables in neat rows to resemble a garden: carrots and radishes with trimmed tops, celery stalks, sugar snap peas, asparagus and more.
